CVE-2026-92877 concerns XML External Entity injection.
The application does not directly use JAXB, has no endpoints accepting XML, and SQS/SNS communication uses JSON.
Dependency: jaxb-core-4.0.9.jar
This assessment assumes no reachable XML parsing path exists through transitive dependencies.
